name: Tsukuyomi Kinako
source:
"Hah... as I thought, magic is easier than curses" 

 President of the Occult Research Society. None of the other members actually turn up. She immerses herself in strange research day and night. Her personality is strange as well. She speaks with a stupid expression.
[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
